capabilities: Build saved dashboard pages from a source folder
Switch between timeline and board layouts
Filter notes by frontmatter fields with multi-select controls
Drag cards to reorder and optionally update a target field
Export page definitions back into the vault
disambiguation: Not a folder or file manager; it renders the notes inside a chosen folder as cards in timeline and board views.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. UI is localized in Chinese and English; installation is currently manual until community publication.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a folder's notes as a persistent, filterable dashboard with card layouts and manual ordering.
summary: Folder dashboard plugin that renders a folder's notes as interactive timeline or board pages with metadata filters, drag sorting, and saved presets.
